# Files and storage

Ensemble keeps workspace-shape files in the project directory and durable rows in OpenCode plugin storage. The host owns the physical storage format and paths; documentation names the logical prefixes, not a filesystem location.

## Workspace files

| Path | Contents | Safe to edit? |
|---|---|---|
| `<workspace>/.ensemble/config.json` | Workspace name, leader and member names, synthesis, paused, version, optional id. | **Yes**, with valid JSON and resolvable active agent names. See [Configuration](configuration.md). |
| `<workspace>/.ensemble/init.json` | Contract marker with `version` and `installedAt`. | **No.** Restore from a backup; reconciliation reads it. |
| `<workspace>/.ensemble/handoffs/` | Typed Markdown handoff files. The handoff tool enforces realpath containment under this directory. | **Yes** for content, while keeping files under this directory. |
| `<workspace>/.ensemble/attachments/<conversationKey>/` | Attachment bytes and an index file. Transcript rows carry metadata, not bytes. | **No.** Managed by the attachment path. |
| `<workspace>/AGENTS.md` | Project instructions plus the generated Ensemble block between `<!-- ensemble:start v7 -->` and `<!-- ensemble:end -->`. | **Yes outside the block.** Edits inside the block are overwritten when the roster contract refreshes. |
| `<workspace>/.gitignore` | Ensemble appends `.ensemble/` when it creates the directory. | Safe. Ensemble only appends the missing line. |

## Plugin storage

The following logical prefixes are the durable state Ensemble owns. They are stored through the host's plugin storage API, so there is no documented filesystem path and no supported hand-edit workflow.

| Prefix | Contents | Edit policy |
|---|---|---|
| `v2/agent/` | Agents, including archived rows and memory/skill settings. | No supported hand-edit path. Use the RPC or an operator CLI. |
| `v2/workspace/` | Workspaces, members, leader, pause, and synthesis. | No supported hand-edit path. Use the RPC or an operator CLI. |
| `v2/message/` | Group and direct conversation rows, ordered by sequence. | No supported hand-edit path. Use the RPC or an operator CLI. |
| `v2/subtask/` | Work items, review batches, handoff metadata, and turn state. | No supported hand-edit path. Use the RPC or an operator CLI. |
| `v2/dispatchgroup/` | Dispatch-group ledgers and captured hop budgets. | No supported hand-edit path. Use the RPC or an operator CLI. |
| `v2/init/` | Workspace init jobs and their progress. | No supported hand-edit path. Use the RPC or an operator CLI. |
| `v2/native-subagent/` | Native subagent parent/child relationships. | No supported hand-edit path. Use the RPC or an operator CLI. |
| `v2/binding/` | Session bindings and retired-session history. | No supported hand-edit path. Use the RPC or an operator CLI. |
| `v2/memory/` | Memories with scope, provenance, and history. | No supported hand-edit path. Use the RPC or an operator CLI. |
| `v2/approval/` | Approval inbox rows and resolutions. | No supported hand-edit path. Use the RPC or an operator CLI. |
| `v2/dmqueue/` | Queued direct sends. | No supported hand-edit path. Use the RPC or an operator CLI. |
| `v2/dm/` | Legacy direct-message rows kept for migration. | No supported hand-edit path. Use the RPC or an operator CLI. |

Additional rows:

| Key | Contents | Edit policy |
|---|---|---|
| `v2/meta` | Stored settings, UI state, and coordination version. | Use the Settings panel or the validated RPC. |
| `v2/backup/rollback` | One pre-restore rollback slot. | Use the backup rollback command. |
| `ensemble.state` | Legacy pre-v2 state kept for migration. | No hand edit; reset or restore. |

The backup document is `ensemble.backup` format `1`. It contains durable rows plus the derived workspace config and init records. It excludes attachment bytes, handoff files, project content, host sessions, credentials, and logs.

## Logs

Default directory: `$XDG_STATE_HOME/ensemble/logs`, or `~/.local/state/ensemble/logs` when `XDG_STATE_HOME` is unset. `ENSEMBLE_LOG_DIR` overrides it.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Files | Service and TUI JSONL, plus a separate failures sink. Rotated files append `.1` through `.N`. |
| Permissions | Owner-only files in an owner-only directory. |
| Default retention | 7 days |
| Rotated files | At most 5 per role/prefix |
| Maximum size | 10 MiB per file |
| Content | Metadata and IDs by default. Free text only with `ENSEMBLE_LOG_CONTENT=1`; credentials and common token shapes are redacted. |

Logs are safe to delete for privacy, but they are the evidence source for a support bundle. `data delete --logs` removes only matching Ensemble log files.

## OpenCode-owned paths

| Path | Owner | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `$XDG_STATE_HOME/opencode/service.json` | OpenCode | Service descriptor read by doctor, data, backup, and the support bundle. Read-only. |
| `<host-owned plugin storage>` | OpenCode | No documented path; use the RPC and operator CLIs. |
| `<host-owned native sessions>` | OpenCode | Only the host can remove them; data delete needs `--delete-native-sessions` to ask. |

## Safe-to-edit summary

- **Safe:** `.ensemble/config.json`, `AGENTS.md` content outside the Ensemble block, handoff Markdown under `.ensemble/handoffs/`, and `.gitignore` additions.
- **Managed:** the AGENTS block, `.ensemble/init.json`, `.ensemble/attachments/`, every `v2/` storage row, and the rollback slot. Use init, reset, backup, data, or settings.
- **Disposable:** local JSONL logs, with the support-evidence caveat above.

There is no second product configuration file. Agent settings and dispatch limits live in `v2/meta`.
